independence_declaration.statement: qa-verifier authored no product implementation in the DG2 scope. Its only authored files are QA tests and evidence (tests/qa/**, e2e/a20-bilingual-shell.spec.ts, e2e/support/qa-stack.sh, docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG2/qa/**). The round-6 product changes (D-066: T-DG2-BE10 by backend-workflow-engineer, T-DG2-ARCH-02 by solution-architect) touch none of the qa-verifier harness files: tests/qa/** and e2e/** are unchanged between 96a3c293 and 51a692b1. Every result here comes from qa-verifier's own runs on a disposable clone of 51a692b1 under $TMPDIR. During this run, HEAD of the candidate tree moved from bd2e809 to 51b9a0d (the domain reviewer's auto-committed run evidence). qa-verifier did not open those files, and the recomputed candidate ID was unchanged. The verdict was formed without reading any other reviewer's round-6 record.

checks_run.actual: Both trees give sha256:bb3e75811631cbabef8f807972f36396e0be2cf7b1d1b1281fa2fdf16f52eb1f with 528 files, and the manifest has 528 entries and the same ID. HEAD bd2e809 is one commit past 51a692b1, the round-6 freeze, which adds 3 assignments, the manifest and stages.json (none of them manifest files). After HEAD moved to 51b9a0d (domain-reviewer evidence only), the recomputed ID was still bb3e7581 with 528 files.

summary: PASS with no new findings. In a full regression of candidate bb3e7581 (528 files, source 51a692b1), every static check exits 0 and the contract has 161 operations, 160 of which declare 400 (+41; only the redirect-only OIDC callback has none). Unit tests pass 9/9 runs at 656/656 on Node 22 and Node 24, in both locale settings and under CPU load. Integration passes 547/547 in both locale settings: 19 migrations on UTF8, plus contract, blank-text, encoding and invalid-character. Product e2e passes 62/62 per locale, including Define→G2 and Design→G3 in EN and AR, and the QA acceptance stack passes 106/106 per locale, with server_encoding UTF8 logged and no serious or critical axe violation. qa-verifier's own negative checks pass in EN and AR. U+0000 is refused with the localized message, both client-side and through the real server, and nothing is saved. 58/58 GET-by-id operations answer a malformed id with the declared 400 at /params/<name>. The blank-text, invisible-only and F-DG2-230 placeholder checks and the SQL_ASCII/LATIN1 refusal (24/24) are unchanged. The registry, CI and Keycloak residuals (D-057/D-058/D-049) are recorded on their offline or config surfaces. qa-verifier grants no business approval, and product G1-G6 never implies DG7.
